articles.summary: Evotec SE announced that its translational drug discovery accelerator with Novo Nordisk, LAB eN², has selected its first three projects to move forward in the program from Boston University, Harvard University in collaboration with Mass General Brigham, and Joslin Diabetes Center. Read the press release to learn more.
articles.title: Evotec SE announces first projects for LAB eN² with Novo Nordisk
